en.t: How truly changeable and inconstant things are!"

units.source_text: 久病新愈，手指颤抖，随便挥写，笔迹反而秀美可爱。

en.t: Having only just recovered from a long illness, her fingers trembled, and when she wrote casually, the handwriting seemed all the more graceful and charming.

units.source_text: 空蝉看到公子至今不忘记那“蝉壳”[\[38\]](#part1333.html#m38)，觉得对不起他，又觉得有趣。

en.t: When Utsusemi saw that the young lord still had not forgotten that "cicada shell"[\[38\]](#part1333.html#m38), she felt sorry toward him, yet also found it amusing.

units.source_text: 她爱作此种富有情味的通信，却不愿和他直接会面。

en.t: She enjoyed exchanging such emotionally suggestive letters, but she did not wish to meet him face to face.

units.source_text: 她但望一方面冷淡矜持，一方面又不被公子看作不解情趣的愚妇，于愿足矣。

en.t: She wanted only to remain cool and reserved on the one hand, while on the other not being seen by the young lord as a foolish woman who understood nothing of feeling; that would be enough to satisfy her.
